title: Update all packages from repos and AUR
summary: Synchronize and update all installed packages from both the official repositories and the Arch User Repository (AUR).

steps.explain: Runs the default update operation, checking for updates in official repos and AUR, and prompting for confirmation.

rollback.explain: Downgrading packages is complex and not directly supported by a single yay command. It is recommended to use a snapshot tool like Timeshift before updating.

warnings: Always review the list of packages to be updated before confirming. Partial upgrades can break the system.
